sharedInstructions: Article preparation for source https://jas-law-astro-review.netlify.app/ (preserve mode). Shared config: src/content.config.ts defines the blog and docs collections (glob loaders over src/content/blog and src/content/docs; schemas include title, description, pubDate, draft, jsonLd, imageAlt, schemaType, schemaData, featured, toc). src/content/ currently contains no entries. Layouts: src/layouts/BlogLayout.astro (default article type blog), src/layouts/DocsLayout.astro and BaseLayout.astro. Requested paths were classified from source evidence (JSON-LD @type, og:type, page title and content): ProfilePage/Person (attorney profiles), AboutPage (career), ContactPage (contact), CollectionPage listings (reviews, media, case-result pages). None is an individual editorial article, so no MDX entries, targetPath values or collection/layout changes are required for this run. Pages are to be built by the page worker as src/pages routes at the original paths (trailing slash). Existing src/pages files for career, courtroom-victories, media and reviews may be import placeholders; the page worker owns them. Attorney profile paths (/attorneys/joseph-a-simon/ and /attorneys/stephen-adams/) and the paginated case-result paths (/courtroom-victories/2/ through /courtroom-victories/14/) have no matching route in src/pages yet. Source media-article items linked from /media/ (under /media-articles/) are not part of this request and were not classified here. Unresolved: no representative rendered article exists, so article presentation was not judged in this preparation.
